'''Byllura''' was a forested [[Planet/Legends|world]] located within the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
On the main continent of Byllura, a number of rivers flowed down from a plateau into the world's [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]], creating a series of waterfalls. Engineers from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] altered one of the larger river deltas to form a series of terraces, on which the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Hestobyll]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Byllura, was established.

==History==
During the [[New Sith Wars]], Byllura was controlled by the [[Chagras Hegemony]]. Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Chagras]], the ruler of the hegemony, Byllura became the capital of the [[Dyarchy]] and was governed by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] twins [[Dromika]] and [[Quillan (Sith)|Quillan]]. Their reign ended in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]] when Byllura fell to forces of the [[Arkadianate]].

Later on, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet would be located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="EAOC" />
